1556-2645-2872-3430.easyPrerequisites: Clever Conjurer doesn't have summoning sickness.
1556-2645-2872-3430.description:
Activate Scorched Ruins by tapping it, adding twelve {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Clever Conjurer by tapping it, untapping Scorched Ruins
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Clever Conjurer.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1671-2645-3430-7014.easyPrerequisites: North Pole Patrol doesn't have summoning sickness.
1671-2645-3430-7014.description:
Activate Simic Growth Chamber by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate North Pole Patrol by tapping it, untapping Simic Growth Chamber
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping North Pole Patrol.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

140-1170-8210.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-1170-8210.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast a copy of Soul Tether by paying {R/G}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Konstrari Improviser. It'll enter prepared due to its effect.
Resolve Soul Tether, creating a Heartwood token.
Activate the Heartwood by tapping it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat from step 2

5254-6627-6798.easyPrerequisites: You control another creature with power 4 or greater.
5254-6627-6798.description:

When the creature dies, Warbeast of Gorgoroth triggers, creating a 0/0 Army creature token if you don't control one, then putting four +1/+1 counters on an Army you control.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability, causing you to surveil 1
Repeat.

856-5776-6495-7422.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Cauldron Familiar and Garrison Excavator trigger.
Resolve the Garrison Excavator trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Evereth by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
856-5776-6495-7422.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

240-728-1753-5470.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one creature token that entered the battlefield this turn.
Grimgrin is untapped and does not have summoning sickness.
240-728-1753-5470.description:
Activate Atla by paying {2} and tapping it, creating an 0/1 Egg creature token with defender.
Activate a nontoken creature you control using the ability granted to it by Ghired by tapping it, creating a copy of the Egg token.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing an Egg token.
When the Egg dies, Atla triggers, causing you to reveal cards from the top of your library until you reveal a creature card and put it onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Grimgrin and untapping it
Repeat from step 2.
Activate Grimgrin by tapping it, creating a token copy of any creature token you control that entered the battlefield this turn.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing the creature token created in step 1, untapping Grimgrin and putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

3525-3590-6723.description:
Activate Warchanter Skald by tapping it, adding {U}.
Warchanter Skald triggers, creating a creature token
Activate Pemmin's Aura by paying {U}, untapping Warchanter Skald.
Repeat.

372-2781-2955.manaNeeded: {5}{W}{W} plus enough mana to pay commander tax, if applicable
372-2781-2955.description:
Cast Abdel Adrian either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {4}{W} and commander tax, if applicable.
When Abdel Adrian enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abedl Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves and enters the battlefield, causing Felidar Guardian to return to the battlefield from exile, and triggering Abdel Adrian and Felidar Guardian's enter abilities.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Felidar Guardian until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Resolve the Felidar Guardian trigger, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Repeat from step 4.

2946-3967-4871-7316.notablePrerequisites: A non-Skeleton creature has died under your control this turn.
2946-3967-4871-7316.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Cult Conscript.
When Cult Conscript dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Rat King trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Cult Conscript by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1518-2450-4050-7639.easyPrerequisites: Your deck size is at least 2.
1518-2450-4050-7639.description:
Activate Will Kenrith's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to draw two cards and causing instant, sorcery and planeswalker spells you cast to cost {2} less to cast until your next turn.
Cast Whim of Volrath by paying {U} due to Will Kenrith.
Namor triggers, creating a 1/1 Merfolk creature token.
Resolve Whim of Volrath.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Merfolk, adding {U}.
Repeat from step 2.

2558-3000-4779-6737.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters, Barret's first ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Barret trigger, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token and a 1/1 Squirrel creature token due to Chatterfang.
When the Squirrel enters, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning itself from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Squirrel.
Repeat from step 2.

Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by paying {1} and removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens
Activate the tokens by tapping them, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the tokens, putting two charge counters on Spawning Pit.
Repeat.

775-1409-4772.description:
Activate Jewel Thief by paying {1}{U}, blinking it.
When Jewel Thief enters, it and Deadeye Navigator's soulbond ability trigger
Resolve the Deadeye Navigator trigger, repairing it and Jewel Thief.
Resolve the Jewel Thief trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{U}.
Repeat.

2577-6462-6798.description:
Cast Gravecrawler from your graveyard by paying {B}.
Kheru Goldkeeper triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Gravecrawler.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2067-3858-6651.notablePrerequisites: Your life total plus the number of creatures you control is equal to or greater than 19.
2067-3858-6651.description:
Cast Storm Herd by paying {8}{W}{W}, causing you to create a number of 1/1 Pegasus creature tokens equal to your life total.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, Mayael's Aria triggers, causing you to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control, gain ten life and win the game.

856-2099-2279-5776.description:
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food.
Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar ability, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.

Resolve the Quintorius trigger, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Activate Sarcatog by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
When Cauldron Familiar dies, Ygra triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Resolve the Sarcatog ability.
Repeat.

3156-4763-4955-5553.description:
Activate Grafted Wargear's equip ability by paying {0}, attaching it to Greedy Freebooter.
Activate Demonmail Hauberk by sacrificing Greedy Freebooter, targeting Koll.
When Greedy Freebooter dies, it and Koll trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Resolve the Koll trigger, returning Greedy Freebooter from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Demonmail Hauberk ability, attaching it to Koll.
Cast Greedy Freebooter by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

864-4377-6122.notablePrerequisites: {1}{U} available plus enough mana to cast Walk the Aeons and Eternal Witness each turn.
864-4377-6122.description:
Cast Walk the Aeons by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Eternal Witness by paying its mana cost.
When Eternal Witness enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Walk the Aeons from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Dour Port-Mage by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, returning Eternal Witness from the battlefield to your hand.
Dour Port-Mage triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

1571-2154-4875-5728.notablePrerequisites: Aspiring Champion does not have summoning sickness, and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1571-2154-4875-5728.description:
Cast Sylvan Tutor by paying {G}, searching your library for Blightsteel Colossus and putting it on top of your library.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Aspiring Champion.
Aspiring Champion triggers, causing you to sacrifice it, then reveal Blightsteel Colossus from the top of your library and put it onto the battlefield as a Demon due to Conspiracy, then causing Blightsteel Colossus to give each opponent eleven poison counters.
Each opponent loses the game as a state-based action due to having ten or more poison counters.

526-1621-3280.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one other nontoken creature with base power 4 or greater.
526-1621-3280.description:

When the Wispweaver Angel token enters the battlefield, it triggers, blinking any creature you control with base power 4 or greater.
When the creature enters the battlefield, Life Finds A Way triggers, creating a token copy of the Wispweaver Angel token.
Repeat from step 2.

141-914-1860-2332.notablePrerequisites:
Opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
There is at least one other creature on the battlefield.
141-914-1860-2332.description:
Activate Emergence Zone's second ability by paying {1}, allowing you to cast spells this turn as though they have flash.
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{U}{R}.
Cast Step Through by paying {3}{U}{U}, targeting any two creatures.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Naru Meha enters the battlefield, it triggers, copying Step Through, targeting Dockside Extortionist and Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Step Through, returning Dockside Extortionist and Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat steps 2-4 one additional time.
Repeat from step 6.

428-664-3908-4983.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to give Frilled Deathspitter indestructible.
You have a way to deal damage to Frilled Deathspitter.

Frilled Deathspitter, Ghyrson Starn, and Spark Double trigger.
Resolve the Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 2 damage to Frilled Deathspitter, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Spark Double and Frilled Deathspitter trigger.
Resolve the Frilled Deathspitter trigger, dealing 2 damage to target opponent.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger, dealing 2 damage to Frilled Deathspitter, with all but 1 of that damage being prevented by Temple Altisaur.
Ghyrson Starn and Frilled Deathspitter trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

4038-4390-4893.description:
Activate Meria's first ability by tapping Farmstead Gleaner, adding {G}.
Activate Farmstead Gleaner by paying {1} and untapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

Whip Silk enters the battlefield, triggering Chishiro, creating two 2/2 Spirit creature tokens.
Activate Phyrexian Altar twice by sacrificing both Spirit tokens, adding {G}{G}.
Activate Whip Silk by paying {G}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
